null_definition: independent same-norm edits matched to each selected CCA edit on each row
selection: minimum development KL to native target-layer donor, then lexical candidate name; select separately by method
final_donors: same template and name pair, reversed roles; keep every row
final_split: three new templates; 66 rows using training names and 30 rows including unseen names
final_conditions: all 17 development candidates, native donor, no-op, baseline, 16 same-norm null draws per layer pair
control_claim: full-vocabulary KL measures reproduction of an actual local donor intervention, not unrestricted task accuracy
